title: How I built an Apple Watch app for Amy in 2 hours with Codex in ChatGPT desktop 👀 #ChatGPT_Partner
description:
Story time…

I remember trying to build an Apple Watch app 3 years ago and giving up 🥲 so its kind of wild you can build one in like 2 hours with Codex inside of the ChatGPT app (#ad)

I remember struggling to get data to pull from the iPhone app into the watch app

I also remember struggling to deal with loading images on the watch face because Apple is super strict when it comes to image size and memory consumption, Probably wasted three whole days until I figured that one out 😬

That’s why I gave up and never ended up shipping one for any of my other apps

BUT THAT CHANGES TODAY

This was my actual workflow to ship the new Apple Watch app for Amy. My secret was using the goal feature to spin up a long-running task so it was able to get the first version working in one prompt

@OpenAI #ChatGPT_Partner
